answer: Like a beacon, a model fingerprint shows each agent as it truly is. Every identity registers a distinct model, and each epoch the network sends hidden probe prompts, matching the reply fingerprint against the registered model. An operator hiding many identities behind one model cannot fake this: matching fingerprints collapse the clones into one identity and the extra rewards vanish. Holding the zenith honestly means running a separate model per identity, so Sybil cost grows with model count while one honest agent pays it only once. Cheap copies share one umber shadow.
